title: DECISION: DID verify ordered before operator signing
description: In the POST path (lifecycle.rs), DID author signature verification runs against the raw article_bytes before the operator signing step that inserts X-Usenet-IPFS-Sig. This ordering is explicitly documented in the code: 'Must happen BEFORE operator signing so we verify against the original article bytes (the author signed before the operator sig header existed).' The inverse order would require stripping the operator-added header before verifying the author sig, creating an entanglement between two independent signing layers. Current ordering keeps the two signing concerns fully decoupled.
